docs.summary: A per-thread bump pool of [`Instruction`](#api~Prowl.Prism.SpirV.Instruction) objects, mirroring glslang's TPoolAllocator: a compile reuses the objects (and their operand lists) allocated by the previous compile on this thread, so after warm-up the front-end allocates zero instructions. [`Reset`](#api~Prowl.Prism.SpirV.InstrPool~Reset) is called at the start of every compile (nothing is individually freed; the used-index simply rewinds). Thread-static, so concurrent compiles on different threads never share.

Suspends pooling on this thread while a second, concurrently-live compile runs. The pooled instructions belong to the compile that claimed them; rewinding or handing them out again would overwrite instructions that compile still references.
